# Static Vibes

> Premium fashion, custom posters, and curated lifestyle products delivered across Bangladesh with Cash on Delivery, bKash, and Nagad.

Static Vibes is a Bangladesh-based e-commerce store offering premium clothing, custom-designed posters, and curated lifestyle items. We focus on quality fabrics, original designs, and fast nationwide delivery.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Featured collections, hero banners, and new arrivals.
- [Shop](/shop): Full catalog with filters by category, color, size, and price.
- [Customize](/customize): Design your own custom poster.
- [About](/about): Our story, mission, and team.
- [Contact](/contact): Phone, email, WhatsApp, and store location.
- [Order Tracking](/order-tracking): Track an order by ID or phone number.
- [Return Policy](/return-policy): Return and exchange rules.
- [Terms & Conditions](/terms-conditions): Site terms of use.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy-policy): How we handle customer data.

## Optional

- [Wishlist](/wishlist): Saved products (requires sign-in).
